newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares down, KTM motorcycles gleam.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares down, KTM motorcycles gleam.

text.p: Austrian shares ended moderately lower on Tuesday in generally lacklustre trade with selective demand restricted to motorcycle manufacturer KTM and Vienna airport company Flughafen Wien.
Market participants forecast a period of sideways trading before a fresh assault on the upside.
The ATX index of 21 blue chip shares closed 2.27 points down at 1,172.94 with seven issues up, 11 down and three unchanged. February ATX futures stood 1.4 points down at 1,180.
In continuous trade, Austria's lone motorcycle manufacturer KTM was the biggest gainer and among the most actively traded stocks, rising 2.8 percent to 662 schillings on 32,096 contracts.
"KTM is really taking off now," said a trader, forecasting an advance towards 700 schillings, well above December's 595 schilling issue price.

Flughafen Wien also took flight after the firm reiterated it planned to raise its 1996 dividend to 16 schillings from 12 despite lower earnings. Flughafen climbed nine schillings to 579 and dominated trade with 113,449 contracts.
"We want to send a signal to our investors by raising the dividend," Flughafen told Reuters last week.
Points maker VA Eisenbahnsysteme was the biggest decliner, down 2.5 pct to 1,129 schillings.
The broad-based Vienna Bourse index slipped 1.09 points to 438.61. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
